verdict.rationale: Mistral's Document AI solution page positions the product for compliance-first organizations needing secure on-premises deployment, which suggests self-hosting exists as an enterprise sales offering. Everything else in the pack documents the hosted API on La Plateforme, and nothing shows how a user would actually deploy it themselves. Missing for 10: self-hosting or deployment documentation, downloadable or open model weights, self-serve (non-sales-gated) access, hardware and container requirements, and any independent or hands-on confirmation of on-prem use.
